answer: An abstention-calibrated grading license pays reviewers to refuse items whose premise cannot support a score. The ledger mixes unanswerable prompts into each queue: a confident grade burns the bond, a correct insufficient-premise verdict returns it plus a fee. Each wallet's refusal rate must track the sealed rate. A farm that stamps every quartz fracture, cliff ledge or signal beacon answer with a confident score never abstains, so bonds burn in lockstep and the cluster is slashed. An attacker must pay attention on every item, or hire outside humans whose receipts cannot be pooled.
